lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਲ ਮੰਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa gurasikhaa kau har sa(n)tusat hai tinee satigur kee gal ma(n)nee ||
lines.translation: Those Gursikhs, with whom the Lord is pleased, accept the Word of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਚੜੀ ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੀ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo guramukh naam dhiaaide tinee chaRee chavagan va(n)nee ||12||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam are imbued with the four-fold color of the Lord's Love. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਇਰੁ ਕਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh kaair karoop hai bin naavai nak naahi ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is cowardly and ugly; lacking the Name of the Lord, his nose is cut off in disgrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin dha(n)dhai viaapiaa supanai bhee sukh naahi ||
lines.translation: Night and day, he is engrossed in worldly affairs, and even in his dreams, he finds no peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh hovahi taa ubarahi naahi ta badhe dukh sahaahi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he shall be saved; otherwise, he is held in bondage, and suffers in pain. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sadaa dar sohane gur kaa sabad kamaahi ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs always look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadaa sukh dar sachai sobhaa paahi ||
lines.translation: There is a lasting peace and happiness deep within them; at the Court of the True Lord, they receive honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh har naam paaiaa sahaje sach samaahi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with the Name of the Lord; they merge imperceptibly into the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh prahilaad jap har gat paaee ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, Prahlaad meditated on the Lord, and was saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh janak har naam liv laaee ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, Janak lovingly centered his consciousness on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਸਿਸਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh basisat har upades sunaaee ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, Vashisht taught the Teachings of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur har naam na kinai paaiaa mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, no one has found the Lord's Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਹਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har bhagat har aap lahaaee ||13||
lines.translation: The Lord blesses the Gurmukh with devotion. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee parateet na aaeeaa sabad na laago bhaau ||
lines.translation: One who has no faith in the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of the Shabad,

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਸ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਉ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: os no sukh na upajai bhaavai sau geRaa aavau jaau ||
lines.translation: shall find no peace, even though he may come and go hundreds of times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh sahaj milai sache siu liv laau ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meets the True Lord with natural ease; he is in love with the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man aisaa satigur khoj lahu jit seviai janam maran dukh jaai ||
lines.translation: O mind, search for such a True Guru, by serving whom the pains of birth and death are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahasaa mool na hovaee haumai sabad jalaai ||
lines.translation: Doubt shall never afflict you, and your ego shall be burnt away through the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਪਾਲਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooRai kee paal vichahu nikalai sach vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: The veil of falsehood shall be torn down from within you, and Truth shall come to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t man sukh hoi sach sa(n)jam kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: Peace and happiness shall fill your mind deep within, if you act according to truth and self-discipline.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak poorai karam satigur milai har jeeu kirapaa kare rajaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, you shall meet the True Guru, and then the Dear Lord, by His Sweet Will, shall bless you with His Mercy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kai ghar deebaan har hovai tis kee muthee vich jagat sabh aaiaa ||
lines.translation: The whole world comes under the control of one whose home is filled with the Lord, the King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਤਲਕੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kau talakee kisai dee naahee har deebaan sabh aan pairee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: He is subject to no one else's rule, and the Lord, the King, causes everyone to fall at his feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸਾ ਕਿਅਹੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਸਿ ਭਜਿ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanasaa kiahu deebaanahu koee nas bhaj nikalai har deebaanahu koee kithai jaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One may run away from the courts of other men, but where can one go to escape the Lord's Kingdom?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਹਦੇ ਖੁਹਦੇ ਆਣਿ ਸਭਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਗੈ ਖਲਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so aisaa har deebaan vasiaa bhagataa kai hiradai tin rahade khuhade aan sabh bhagataa agai khalavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is such a King, who abides in the hearts of His devotees; He brings the others, and makes them stand before His devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: har naavai kee vadiaaee karam paraapat hovai guramukh viralai kinai dhiaaiaa ||14||
lines.translation: The glorious greatness of the Lord's Name is obtained only by His Grace; how few are the Gurmukhs who meditate on Him. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve jagat muaa birathaa janam gavaai ||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, the people of the world are dead; they waste their lives away in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai at dukh lagaa mar ja(n)mai aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: In love with duality, they suffer terrible pain; they die, and are reincarnated, and continue coming and going.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: visataa a(n)dar vaas hai phir phir joonee paai ||
lines.translation: They live in manure, and are reincarnated again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai jam maarasee a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, the Messenger of Death punishes them; in the end, they depart regretting and repenting. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰ ਸਗਲੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jag mahi purakh ek hai hor sagalee naar sabaaee ||
lines.translation: In this world, there is one Husband Lord; all other beings are His brides.
